title: Creative Merge Rejection Reason
description: Why a seller rejected a sync_creatives merge assignment operation. Carried in CREATIVE_MERGE_REJECTED error details so a buyer can tell a pairing the seller judged wrong from one the buyer must fix.

enumDescriptions.content_mismatch: The seller judges that merged_creative_id is not the same creative as creative_id: its content differs. The seller's copy is a different creative; to run creative_id on the package, use replace.
enumDescriptions.format_mismatch: creative_id cannot take over the serving object because its format differs from merged_creative_id's (for example, a different format kind or dimensions). The buyer can sync a matching format of creative_id and retry.
enumDescriptions.not_on_package: merged_creative_id is not a seller-assigned creative currently assigned to package_id in this account. Covers unknown IDs, buyer-assigned creatives, and creatives assigned elsewhere, so the response does not reveal whether an ID exists outside this package.
enumDescriptions.not_supported: The seller supports merge but cannot merge this pairing on this package (for example, a channel or object type the seller cannot hand over without re-trafficking). Use replace. For a library-level merge, the rejection names the blocking package_id.
enumDescriptions.not_in_account: Library-level merge only: merged_creative_id is not a seller-assigned creative in this account. Covers unknown IDs and buyer-assigned creatives, so the response does not reveal whether an ID exists in another account.
enumDescriptions.already_merged: Library-level merge only: an earlier library-level merge already bound merged_creative_id to a different creative_id. A seller-assigned creative is bound to at most one buyer creative.
